note: Files are synthesized with FFmpeg (no external audio, no licence issues). Raw levels are uneven on purpose: Phase 9 sets each cue's data-volume against the VO. Peak position = seconds into the file where the transient lands, so place_frame = visual_hit_frame + 1 - round(peak_s*30).

pop-a.wav.use: soft pop; alternate with pop-b so no take repeats back to back

tick.wav.use: clock spin run (01), ring (08), timeline dots (11)

whoosh-a.wav.use: rotation A, then B, then C

riser-impact.wav.use: 05 only; impact at 1.2 s, so start at f1737+1-36 = f1702

not_included: Room-tone air bed (optional, Phase 9). No music per SPEC.
